exercises.rehab_purpose_zh: 重建跟腱/小腿负荷耐受
exercises.rehab_cues_zh: 扶墙单腿缓起缓落，3 秒离心
exercises.rehab_cues_en: Slow 3s eccentric, hold the wall for balance

exercises.rehab_cues_zh: 对侧手脚伸展，骨盆不晃
exercises.rehab_cues_en: Extend opposite arm/leg; keep hips level

exercises.rehab_cues_zh: 弹力带固定膝后，后坐至 60° 保持
exercises.rehab_cues_en: Band behind knees; sit back to ~60° and hold

exercises.rehab_cues_zh: 用脚尖在空中书写 A–Z，全程无痛
exercises.rehab_cues_en: Trace A–Z with the toes, pain-free

exercises.rehab_cues_zh: 肘不弯，只做肩胛前伸/后缩

exercises.rehab_purpose_zh: 强化股内侧肌、稳定髌骨
exercises.rehab_cues_zh: 弹力带套膝后，缓慢完全伸直，顶峰收缩 2 秒
exercises.rehab_cues_en: Band behind the knee; extend fully and hold 2s

profile.goal: Recomp — keep adding strength while dropping body fat

injuries.note_raw: Rolled the ankle landing on an opponent at a frisbee league game — grade I–II lateral ligament sprain. Proprioception work after swelling settled.
injuries.note_zh: 飞盘联赛落地踩到对方脚,外侧韧带 I–II 度扭伤。消肿后开始本体感觉训练。
injuries.note_en: Rolled the ankle landing on an opponent at a frisbee league game — grade I–II lateral ligament sprain. Proprioception work after swelling settled.

injuries.note_raw: Anterior pinching after bench/overhead pressing, painful through the overhead arc. Deloaded pressing and added scapular-stability work.
injuries.note_zh: 卧推与过顶推举后肩前侧夹挤感,过顶弧度疼痛。减量并加入肩胛稳定训练。
injuries.note_en: Anterior pinching after bench/overhead pressing, painful through the overhead arc. Deloaded pressing and added scapular-stability work.

injuries.note_raw: Patellar-tendon pain below the kneecap after a running-volume spike; worse on stairs. Resolved with isometric loading + graded return.
injuries.note_zh: 跑量骤增后髌腱下缘疼痛,上下楼加重。等长负荷 + 逐步复训后痊愈。
injuries.note_en: Patellar-tendon pain below the kneecap after a running-volume spike; worse on stairs. Resolved with isometric loading + graded return.

injuries.note_raw: Tweaked the lower back lifting a box with poor form. Recovered with anti-rotation core work; returned to deadlifts.
injuries.note_zh: 搬重物姿势不良导致腰部拉伤。核心抗旋转训练后恢复,硬拉回归。
injuries.note_en: Tweaked the lower back lifting a box with poor form. Recovered with anti-rotation core work; returned to deadlifts.
